gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-noto-serif-aho: Blocky, bold uprights with horizontals like faint scratches. Noto Serif Ahom lifts that into a tall, traditional lowercase whose hairlines stay sturdy, and that sturdiness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-noto-serif-dog: Minecraftia swells and thins its strokes in a pronounced, playful way, one character per beat. Noto Serif Dogra softens that into a bookish body where heavy stems shift only mildly to lighter curves, so the page settles after the heading's fuss.

gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-noto-serif-lao: Minecraftia is all drama, with a stroke ratio pushed hard and a towering lowercase that lingers on each character. And Noto Serif Lao, bookish and authoritative, carries a long page smoothly, its horizontals only slightly slimmer than its verticals.

gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-quando: Wild swings in stroke weight, one character per beat. Quando answers with a low-contrast, bookish body and sparse, wide spacing, leaving the heading to do its loudest work at display sizes.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-plein: Floating letters, short ascenders, and a c opened like calipers. Plein follows with a reliable, clean body, its round forms approached through a clear channel, while Nasalization is happiest large, in a few friendly words.
